content: No single documented 'best practice' exists for linking a new Google OAuth identity to a pre-existing Stripe customer; the general pattern synthesized from Google account-linking docs and Stripe/Auth0 integration guides is: on first login, look up Stripe customers by email (list or search), and if exactly one match exists, link it to the new user record; if none exists, create a new Stripe customer at first checkout. Ambiguous/multiple matches or an unverified email should not auto-link without an explicit confirmation step, since email alone is not proof of purchase ownership in adversarial cases (though Google's email_verified claim narrows this materially for a Google-only auth model).
